question: Are the six deposited baseline exon-count files and eight called-peak files structurally consistent with their documented technical formats?
decision: Qualify input format for later job-specific decisions without estimating biological effects or supplying infection-response/intervention outputs.
strongest_rival: Malformed rows, repeated identifiers, invalid counts/coordinates or denominator confusion can create false assurance about downstream measurement validity.
discriminator: Per-file parser checks, exact source hashes, cross-file identifier-universe checks and an independent dataframe calculation; no condition-level comparison.
exposure_record: Paper and source_v1/v2 metadata plus completed human analyses are exposed. Original baseline files were previously downloaded/inventoried; this new job computes structural format diagnostics only. The full paper includes N.brasiliensis history and later IAV challenge; baseline is not absence of infection history.
biological_unit: Not applicable to this technical audit: files and rows. Mouse animal/pool identities and independence remain unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: Rows nest in libraries; source-labeled libraries may contain pooled/overlapping material. No library or row is promoted to an independent animal.
population_and_selection: All six cached exon-count files and all eight cached baseline narrowPeak files with exact source_v1 hashes. No file exclusion, selected gene/locus, biological grouping or new challenge matrix processing.
contrast: Exact file/row consistency and parser agreement only; no biological contrast.
endpoint: Row/identifier universes, duplicates, valid integer/nonnegative exon counts, zero/all-zero feature counts, per-file exon-hit and summary-category totals; interval coordinates, duplicate intervals, width summaries and numeric/missing-field diagnostics.
methods: Stream two-column exon files and ten-column narrowPeak files; separate underscore count-summary rows from exon features; compare ID sets/order; retain all rows in diagnostics. Independently read with pandas for arithmetic. Peak signal/score fields are never treated as read counts. No group tests, foldchanges, PCA, enrichment, gene ranking, susceptibility/tolerance prediction or intervention prioritization in this contract.
missingness_and_exclusions: Report invalid/missing fields and duplicate records; do not silently repair/drop source files. Zero counts stay zero. The exact -1 sentinel and textual NA/blank/nan in signal/p/q fields are recorded as missing; invalid coordinates remain flagged. No outlier exclusion.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests, p-values or biological inference.
precision_basis: Exact structural accounting on deposited files, not population precision or power.
interpretation_limit: Passing file-format checks cannot establish unique gene/fragment semantics, biological independence, author-model equivalence, ATAC read-level QC, temporal mechanism or safety clearance of another task. Basic peak format does not check chromosome-size/build concordance, full BED conformance, score integer0..1000 convention, read depth or FRiP.
stop_rule: Stop on hash/parse/independent-verification conflicts and preserve failed receipts and partial diagnostics. Structural issues produce explicit eligibility flags. No change to frozen source files, no restricted response modeling and no intervention ranking.
amendment_reason: New independently scoped neutral metadata job after source-level assessment and reviewer clearance; preserves original broader-stage holds and all existing evidence.
